bio: Blake Byers is founder of Byers Capital, a San Francisco family office he started in 2021 to invest early-stage in tech and biotech. Before that he spent a decade as a partner at GV, where he made early investments in Robinhood and Gusto. He also co-founded NewLimit with Brian Armstrong.
hook: You backed Robinhood early as a GV partner; we build RL trading environments and verifiers for LLM post-training, and ours lifted an open model's trading performance 12% on unseen market data.
fund_route: Firm site https://www.byerscap.com/; no pitch inbox or form published

name: John Tough
title: Co-founder & Managing Partner
bio: John Tough co-founded Energize Capital, a Chicago firm investing in energy-transition software, and serves as its Managing Partner. The firm reports $1.7B AUM and more than 35 portfolio companies. He sits on the boards of Sitetracker, DroneDeploy, Nozomi Networks, Matroid, PVcase and Aurora Solar.
hook: You co-founded Energize, which led Nixtla's $16M Series A in February 2026 for time-series foundation models; we built the Xitadel trading environment, which lifted an open model's performance 12% on unseen market data.
fund_route: Contact form on his blog johntough.com (invites Energize inquiries); team page https://energizecap.com/team/john-tough

name: Jeff Terrell
title: Managing Partner
bio: Jeff Terrell is Managing Partner at Arboretum Ventures, an early-stage healthcare and medtech venture firm he joined in March 2025. He previously spent 13 years at Hatteras Venture Partners in Durham, co-leading the medical-device practice. His boards include AtaCor Medical, Boomerang Medical and Pharaoh Neuro.
fund_route: Investment Opportunity Form: https://www.arboretumvc.com/contact/

name: Mengxi Lu
title: Angel investor; Co-founder & CEO, Kanmon
bio: Mengxi Lu is co-founder and CEO of Kanmon, which lets vertical software and marketplace companies offer financing to business customers, and an angel writing $5K-$50K checks mostly into early-stage fintech, data infrastructure and AI. He previously worked at Mission Lane/LendUp and Tumblr, and his angel portfolio includes Moov and Salsa.
hook: You angel-invested in fintech infrastructure like Moov and Salsa, with a thesis spanning data infrastructure and AI; we built Xitadel, a trading RL environment where fintech meets AI infrastructure.
fund_route: No published inbox; personal site https://mengxi.lu/ or Wellfound https://wellfound.com/p/mengxi
fit_note: Thesis fits (fintech, data infrastructure, AI), but checks are small ($5K-$50K) and his latest recorded deal is from 2023, so the rule gives Medium, not High.

name: Ali Behbahani
title: Partner & Co-Head of Healthcare
duke: Bachelor's degrees in Biomedical Engineering, Electrical Engineering & Chemistry (year not published)
bio: Ali Behbahani is a Partner and co-head of healthcare at NEA, which he joined in 2007, focusing on biopharmaceuticals and medical devices. His board roles include CRISPR Therapeutics, Black Diamond Therapeutics and Korro Bio. He holds an MD and an MBA, and earlier did research at the NIH and Duke.
hook: You co-head NEA's healthcare practice, with boards including CRISPR Therapeutics; we build RL environments for LLM post-training, outside your sector, so we'd value an intro to NEA's tech partners.
fund_route: No founder pitch inbox found; ask him for an intro to NEA's technology partners

name: Doug Brown
title: Co-founder & Managing Partner
bio: Doug Brown is Co-founder and Managing Partner of Dental Innovation Alliance, which funds early-stage dental-technology companies through its VC Fund I. He spent about 30 years in dentistry, including as CEO of a North Carolina-based 20-practice group that later merged into larger DSOs. DIA's portfolio includes dental-AI companies Relu and DentalBee.
hook: You co-founded Dental Innovation Alliance, which backed Relu's seed and Series A for AI that automates dental case work; we build the expert data and verifiers domain-specific AI like that depends on.
fund_route: inquiries@dialliance.com or the inquiry form at https://www.dialliance.com/contact-us

name: Paul Straub
title: Co-founder & Managing Partner
bio: Paul Straub co-founded Wireframe Ventures, a Mill Valley seed-stage fund backing founders who improve the health of people and planet, and is its Managing Partner. He led investments including Electriphi (acquired by Ford), OpenInvest (acquired by JPMorgan), Span and Salient Predictions.
hook: You led Wireframe's investment in OpenInvest, an impact-investing fintech later acquired by JPMorgan; we built Xitadel, a trading RL environment that lifted an open model's performance 12% on unseen market data.
fund_route: Founder form https://www.wireframevc.com/general/contact-us (climate, bio, health focus); info@wireframevc.com for general inquiries

name: Steve Pagliuca
title: Founder & CEO
bio: Steve Pagliuca is founder and CEO of PagsGroup, his single-LP family investment firm, and a senior advisor to Bain Capital, where he was previously co-chairman. PagsGroup co-led Liquid AI's seed round in December 2023 and Memcyco's $37M Series A in January 2026. He sits on Duke's Board of Trustees.
hook: You co-led Liquid AI's seed through PagsGroup and named AI a key investment focus in July 2026; we build RL environments and verifiers for post-training foundation models.
fund_route: 'Get in Touch' section on the official site https://www.pagsgroup.com/ (no published inbox)

name: Lisa Burton O'Toole
title: Executive Director
bio: Lisa Burton O'Toole invests at HearstLab, Hearst's early-stage arm backing women-led startups in media, data, technology and finance, which she joined as a vice president in 2017 before becoming Executive Director. She previously launched and sold marketing-technology startup AdMass and holds an MS and PhD in mechanical engineering from MIT.
hook: You took AdMass through HearstLab's program before joining to invest in women-led data and technology startups; we're a seed-stage data company supplying RL environments and expert data to Surge AI and AfterQuery.

name: Melinda French Gates
title: Founder
duke: BS Computer Science & Economics '86 · MBA, Fuqua '87
bio: Melinda French Gates is founder of Pivotal Ventures, which invests mainly as an LP in women-led funds and increasingly directly in startups serving women and families. Pivotal made a $3M direct investment in Binti, an AI-driven child-welfare software company, in 2026. In June 2026 she committed another $215M to Pivotal for women's health.
hook: You backed Binti's AI-driven child-welfare software with a $3M direct investment from Pivotal; we build the RL environments and expert data that make models reliable in specialised domains.

name: Lindy Morris Fishburne
title: Founding Managing Partner
bio: Lindy Morris Fishburne is founding managing partner of Breakout Ventures, whose $114M Fund III (March 2026) backs seed and Series A startups applying AI to biology, chemistry and neuroscience, with $500K-$5M checks. She was previously executive director of Breakout Labs, the Thiel Foundation's grant program for early-stage science research.
hook: You raised Breakout's $114M Fund III to back startups 'unlocking the complexity of science with AI'; we build the RL environments and verifiers that teach models expert-domain reasoning.
fund_route: contact@breakout.vc (general inbox on https://breakout.vc/contact)
fit_note: Record says Medium; Fund III applies AI to biology, chemistry and neuroscience (biotech/sustainability), a sector mismatch rather than AI infrastructure.

name: Kerry Rupp
title: General Partner
bio: Kerry Rupp has been general partner at Austin-based True Wealth Ventures since 2016; the fund makes seed investments in women-led companies that improve human or environmental health. She was previously CEO of the DreamIt accelerator and held VP roles at AllRecipes and LexisNexis. She also teaches the NSF I-Corps program.
hook: You teach the NSF I-Corps program on commercializing university research; we're quants turning that kind of research into RL training environments and verifiers for LLMs.
fund_route: Pitch form: https://truewealthvc.com/share-your-big-idea/ (contact page: https://truewealthvc.com/contact-us/)

name: Camille Samuels
title: Partner
bio: Camille Samuels is a partner at Venrock, the venture firm that began as the Rockefeller family's venture arm. She invests in early-stage biotech, medical devices and consumer health, preferring to back or help create seed-stage companies. Her boards include Cavalry, Iris, Mahzi and Unity.
fund_route: Contact page https://www.venrock.com/contact/; business plans go to the relevant investment team (technology or healthcare).

name: Padowithz "Pad" Alce
title: Angel investor; Founding Partner, AI Patent Law
bio: Pad Alce is founding partner of AI Patent Law, a Charlotte-based AI and machine-learning patent boutique whose clients, from pre-seed startups to unicorns, have raised over $2B. He invests through Duke Capital Partners, lectures at Duke, and leads IP strategy at ForgeUp Ventures, an AI/ML venture studio.
hook: You founded AI Patent Law, which serves about 60 AI-native startups; we build proprietary RL environments and verifiers, such as our Xitadel trading environment, for LLM post-training.
fund_route: Info@aiPatentLaw.com (his law firm's general inbox, not a fund)
